summary: Frontend-only validation of two changes: (a) Leave feature moved out of sidebar into My Work as a 'Leave' view tab, (b) task Complete now shows confirm() dialog and completed tasks have a Reopen action. All flows passed end-to-end as the owner (owner@sharma.com / demo1234).

issues: Non-blocking React hydration console warning: '<span> cannot be a child of <option>'. Traced to Emergent Visual Editor devtools injecting <span style={display:contents}> inside <option> elements in PROGRESS/STATUS <select> in /app/frontend/src/pages/MyWork.js (lines ~577, 581). Injected span carries x-excluded="true" data-ve-dynamic="true" — appears to originate from the preview instrumentation, not app code. Rendering & functionality are unaffected. Safe to ignore for prod build; report to platform if it becomes noisy.

critical_code_review_comments: MyWork.js is now 823 lines and continues to grow (TaskCard, ExecutionPlan, TaskTrail, UpdateForm, MyWork). Consider splitting TaskCard and its sub-components into /app/frontend/src/components/task/ to keep files under ~700 lines.

Complete uses window.confirm — good for the accidental-click fix, but not automatable via UI kit dialog and can't be styled. Consider migrating to shadcn AlertDialog for consistency with the rest of the app's brutal UI.

reopen() PATCHes {status:'in_progress', progress:0} directly. If a task had approval_required and was already approved, reopening leaves approval_status intact — behavior looks correct, but worth documenting so approvers aren't re-asked.

Leave.js embedded prop nicely hides its PageHeader, but MyWork's PageHeader title stays 'MY WORK' even when the Leave view is active. Minor: could switch eyebrow/title based on view for better breadcrumbing (nice-to-have).
seed_data_creation: Submitted one PENDING casual leave 'TEST_leave_from_mywork' via embedded Request Leave dialog. Completed then reopened an existing task 'Sales Review Meeting (Next Friday at 4:00 PM)' — final state IN_PROGRESS 0% (reset by the reopen flow, matches spec).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Iteration_50 fully validated the Leave backend (22/22 PASS) + full standalone Leave UI. Iteration_51 covered ONLY the two deltas: (1) Leave-in-MyWork migration and (2) task Complete-confirm + Reopen. Verified: no [data-testid=nav-leave] in sidebar; /leave → /my-work?view=leave; work-view-leave renders <Leave embedded/> (no page header, right-aligned actions); leave-tab-mine/approvals/settings visible for owner; Request Leave submit produces a PENDING chip immediately; task Complete triggers confirm() (Playwright dialog handler must be attached with page.on('dialog', d.accept())); reopen-<taskId> is present inside reopen-actions-<taskId> container on Completed tab; Reopen restores task to In Progress, 0% progress, and it appears in All tab.
rca of the issue: N/A — all requested flows worked as designed. Only observation: dev-only preview-instrumentation injects a <span> inside <option>, which React logs as an HTML hierarchy warning. It carries x-excluded='true' and is from the Visual Editor overlay, not the app source — no fix needed.
